html:
SMTO-EXE-0207 — A file with that name already exists

GUID: 6d39ea60-acfd-5558-9544-0d5a8190af32
Slug: pdf-output-conflict
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: pdf

What happened

  • SMTO was asked to save the PDF result under a name that's already taken. It never replaces existing files, so it saved nothing and left the existing file as it was.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask again and give a file name that isn't already used in that folder, for example add "-v2" to the name. SMTO only creates new files, so a fresh name lets it save without touching the existing one.
  2. Or leave out the file name and let SMTO save the result for this run. SMTO then picks a new, unused place, and the file appears under Artifacts from this run.
  3. Before asking again, open the existing file to see whether it's already the result you wanted. An earlier request may have already created it, so you may not need to run the action again.

What success looks like

  • The new file appears under the new name or under Artifacts from this run, and the existing file is unchanged.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the file name you used, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete the existing file unless you're sure you no longer need it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Create-only PDF publication found the destination already present (existing file, directory or symlink), or the Gateway File layer reported already_exists.

What this means

  • Create-only publication found an existing destination/symlink or the File layer returned already_exists. PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.

Why this can happen

  • Create-only publication found an existing destination/symlink or the File layer returned already_exists.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the destination and original receipt to distinguish an earlier successful output from unrelated content.

How to fix it

  • Choose an output_path that does not exist on the selected Gateway, or omit output_path so the result is published as a new artifact bundle in the run's artifact workspace. PdfService._publish uses O_EXCL/Stage commits and directory rename and never overwrites an existing destination.
  • Choose a new output path or omit output_path for a new artifact. Existing files are never overwritten.

Retry and execution caution

  • Choose a new output path or omit output_path for a new artifact. Existing files are never overwritten.

How to verify the fix

  • A deliberately selected new destination is used only for remaining authorized work.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.

Technical notes

  • PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
